This basically follows how we managed it last year, except now they’re separating Origination and Portfolio Management. Regarding Assistants - we should set the bonus targets ourselves rather than leaving it to Asset Ops to decide. For non-investment staff - same deal, we need to define targets (as we agreed earlier this week).

The main challenge remains how to leverage the CedarPoint Connect system to avoid last year’s tedious Excel-CedarPoint Connect-Excel back-and-forth. We’re collaborating with Hannah Ferguson and the Connect team on this.

VPs must still pass through the final firm-wide review, so that adds an extra step for them. The Portfolio Ops meeting results should align with the overall rating distribution going into the final review (i.e., 10/80/10, scale 1-100).

Jennifer
</body>

Here is our plan on Charlotte.

Assistants:

Ranked 1,2,3 by supervisors - pay determined by Me and Brandy.  No meetings.

Karen Smith but in Raleigh:

Traditional ranking with the correct people attending the meetings.  Pay grid determined by Asset Ops.

Analysts and Associates

Ranked as per Kenneth Winters’ %’s and then pay grid determined by Asset Ops
I would like to see 25% - 65% - 10%.  Kenneth disagrees.  This would provide for a quick meeting rather than trying to split them into 4 groups with the top one excluding some great performers.

Managers/Directors

Ranked from 1 to 100 in as many clusters as the groups see fit.  We are going to combine managers and directors into one table.  The ranking is based on this year’s performance and is directly related to pay.  We will have two meetings - one for portfolio managers and one for other commercial staff (origination/finance/etc).  We will not have a pay PRC but will take the results of the rankings and work with individual leaders after the meetings to ensure appropriate compensation.

We will also determine promotions during this meeting using different criteria.

VP's

We will rank all our VPs from 1 to 100 with a group of selected people - some VPs and some MDs.  
This too will be directly related to pay.

Cheers as you Brits say
